statement: The pinned Linux HID and SDL PS4 consumers cover HID output, while inspected Linux USB-audio quirk and mixer-map tables provide no model-specific DualShock 4 audio profile. These public sources do not establish the physical DS4 UAC revision, supported PCM sample rates, channel counts and role layout, mute/volume feature-unit controls, input/output terminal types or isochronous endpoint packet capacities. Missing table entries do not prove that DS4 hardware has no USB audio.

applicability.scope: Pinned consumer-source inspection and negative table lookup only; no physical USB audio descriptors inspected.
